remove.title: Remove {name} from the team?
remove.description: {name} can no longer open this organization. Their categories are unassigned, sign-offs still waiting for them are dropped, and open invites they sent are withdrawn. Sign-offs they already gave stay on record. They get an email saying they were removed.

inline.notEmailed: Invite created for {email}, but the email did not go out. Copy the link and send it to them yourself.

team.invalidDescription: If you were invited again, use the link in the most recent email. Otherwise ask the person who invited you to send it again.
team.usedDescription: This invite has already been accepted or revoked.
team.acceptedDescription: This invite has been accepted. Sign in with the invited address to continue.
team.revokedDescription: This invite was withdrawn. Ask the person who invited you to send a new one.
team.expiredDescription: This invite link has expired. Ask the person who invited you to send it again.

accept.joinDescription: You've been invited to join as {role}.
accept.signInDescription: You've been invited to join as {role}.
accept.forAddress: This invite is for {email}. Use that address to create your account or to sign in.
accept.wrongAccountDescription: This invite was sent to {inviteEmail}. You're signed in as {userEmail}.

ownership.title: Ownership
ownership.noOwner: This organization has no owner at the moment.
ownership.meaning: The owner is always an admin and cannot be removed. If the owner deletes their own account, the organization is deleted with it.
ownership.inviteFirst: To hand over ownership, first invite the person who should take it.
ownership.pendingOwner: You asked to hand ownership to {name}. {name} can accept until {date}.
ownership.pendingOther: {from} asked to hand ownership to {to}, open until {date}.
ownership.offerTitle: {from} wants to hand ownership to you
ownership.offerBody: If you accept, you own this organization and {from} stays an admin. Open until {date}.
ownership.noLongerOpen: This handover is no longer open. Reload the page.

dialog.title: Hand over ownership
dialog.description: The person accepts the handover on this page. Until then you stay the owner; afterwards you stay an admin.
dialog.whyCode: To confirm it is you, we send a code to {email}.
dialog.codeSentTo: Sent to {email}. The code is valid for 10 minutes.
dialog.pickFirst: First choose the member who should take over.
dialog.codeMissing: Enter the six-digit code from the email.
dialog.codeWrong: The code is wrong or has expired. Ask for a new one.
dialog.tooMany: A code was just sent. Wait a few minutes.
dialog.alreadyOpen: A handover is already open. Withdraw it first.
